Full-laser-enabled clean hierarchical structuring and multifunctional synergy for high-performance in vivo 3D-printed implants.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Qirui Zhang, Xinyue Zhang, Shanshan Liang, Jiaru Zhang, Qi Ma et al. Materials today. Bio 2026-06-01 10.1016/j.mtbio.2026.103095
单位: School of Mechanical Engineering & Automation, Beihang University, Beijing, 102206, China.
通讯: Huaming Wang @ National Engineering Laboratory of Additive Manufacturing for Large Metallic Components, Beihang University, 37 Xueyuan [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接涉及3D打印钛植入体的表面改性，通过激光抛光与飞秒激光诱导周期结构结合银纳米颗粒沉积，实现了抗菌与骨整合的协同增强，与用户关于增材制造生物医用植入体的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report fatigue testing or static compression mechanical properties; it focuses on surface hierarchical structuring and bioactivity rather than bulk mechanical performance.
动机· 解决牙种植体长期成功受细菌感染和骨整合不足的挑战
方法· 采用全激光策略，结合激光抛光和飞秒激光诱导周期结构，并空间引导银纳米颗粒沉积
结果· 实现了74.4%的牙龈卟啉单胞菌生物膜减少和38.7%的骨-种植体接触率增加
验证· 通过体外细胞实验和比格犬体内动物实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the dual challenges of bacterial infection and inadequate osseointegration that compromise the long-term success of dental implants.
Method· A full-laser-enabled strategy combining laser polishing and femtosecond laser-induced periodic surface structures (LIPSS) with spatially guided silver nanoparticle deposition on 3D-printed titanium.
Result· The hierarchical structures achieved a 74.4% reduction in Porphyromonas gingivalis biofilm, a 300% increase in effective Ag+ release duration, and a 38.7% increase in bone-implant contact ratio in vivo.
Validation· In vitro cell and bacterial assays and in vivo Beagle dog experiments.

方法· 通过LPBF制造径向壁厚梯度的D-TPMS晶格结构，并进行有限元分析和力学测试。

Motivation· To address stress shielding caused by elastic modulus mismatch between bone and implant materials.
Method· Radially graded D-TPMS lattice structures with varying wall thickness were fabricated via LPBF of 316L stainless steel and analyzed using finite element simulations.
Result· The radially graded lattice exhibited a reduced effective elastic modulus compared to bulk 316L while maintaining yield strength comparable to cortical bone.
Validation· Mechanical compression tests and finite element analysis were performed to validate the mechanical properties.

Towards Automated Discovery: A Review of Generative Models, Multimodal Learning and Closed-Loop Workflows in Inverse Materials Design

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Skim only none Review
Anand Babu, Rogério Almeida Gouvêa, Gian-Marco Rignanese arXiv preprint 2026-06-01 link
相关性: 该综述讨论了生成模型和闭环设计在逆向材料设计中的应用，其方法（如约束生成、贝叶斯优化）可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型优化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学具体问题。
边界: This paper is a review on inverse materials design for crystalline solids, with no FEA surrogate modeling, no biomechanics or implant design context, and no uncertainty quantification for simulation-based optimization.
动机· 将材料发现从正向预测转向满足物理约束的逆向设计。
方法· 综述了生成模型、多模态学习和闭环设计管线在晶体结构逆向设计中的应用。
结果· 总结了不同生成模型的优缺点及常见失败模式，提出了分阶段评估标准。
验证· 无实验验证，为文献综述。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To shift materials discovery from forward prediction to targeted inverse design of candidates satisfying objectives under physical constraints.
Method· This review surveys generative crystal structure models (VAEs, normalizing flows, autoregressive, diffusion), multimodal learning, and closed-loop pipelines integrating conditional generation with Bayesian optimization, reinforcement learning, and active learning.
Result· Key failure modes (surrogate exploitation, diversity collapse, distribution shift, stability-synthesizability gap) are identified, and staged evaluation practices for discovery-grade validation are proposed.
Validation· No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review without original computational or experimental results.

PINNOCHIO: Physics-Informed Neural Network for Coupled Hyperelastic Interface-Volume Simulation in Orthognathic Surgery

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Read now clinical Exp. validation Patient-specific
Jungwook Lee, Daeseung Kim, Kevin Gu, Zhangfeng Hu, Tianshu Kuang et al. arXiv preprint 2026-06-01 link
相关性: 该论文提出的PINNOCHIO框架将物理信息神经网络应用于超弹性软组织变形模拟，其混合顺序分解和sim-to-real策略可直接迁移到植入物-骨界面力学建模中，解决FEA代理建模中的采样效率和约束处理问题。
边界: This paper focuses on facial soft-tissue simulation for orthognathic surgery, not on implant-bone interface mechanics, stress shielding, or hip implant design, and lacks uncertainty quantification.
动机· 解决面部软组织变形预测中高保真FEM计算昂贵与纯深度学习结果不一致的矛盾。
方法· 提出PINNOCHIO框架，通过混合顺序分解解耦骨-软组织界面运动与体积超弹性变形，结合物理约束的sim-to-real适应策略。
结果· 在40例临床数据上，表面精度和物理一致性均优于现有方法，且计算速度显著快于FEM。
验证· 基于40例患者临床队列的表面误差和物理有效性评估。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in patient-specific facial soft-tissue deformation prediction, where high-fidelity FEM is computationally prohibitive and pure deep learning models lack biomechanical consistency.
Method· PINNOCHIO introduces a hybrid sequential decomposition that explicitly separates discontinuous bone-soft-tissue interface movements from continuous volumetric hyperelastic deformation, enabling stable training and a physics-informed sim-to-real adaptation strategy without requiring volumetric ground truth.
Result· On a 40-patient clinical cohort, PINNOCHIO outperforms existing baselines in both surface accuracy and physical validity, achieving substantial speedup over FEM.
Validation· Clinical validation on 40 patients comparing predicted facial surfaces to ground truth, along with assessment of physical consistency (e.g., divergence-free deformation).

边界: This paper focuses on facial soft-tissue simulation for orthognathic surgery, not on implant stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.
动机· 解决正颌手术中面部软组织变形预测的精度-效率权衡问题。

单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Cedars Sinai Medical Center, Los Angeles, CA, USA.
通讯: Rebisi Owhonda @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Cedars Sinai Medical Center, Los Angeles, CA, USA. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接量化了带颈圈三锥柄股骨假体在骨质疏松模型中的下沉、旋转刚度和失效扭矩，与用户关注的髋关节假体应力遮挡和微动研究高度相关。
边界: This paper does not report stress/strain distribution in Gruen zones, does not model bone-implant interface contact mechanics with micromotion values, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 评估带颈圈三锥柄假体在骨质疏松股骨中的抗下沉和抗旋转性能。
方法· 对24个合成骨质疏松股骨植入四种不同假体，进行轴向和扭转循环加载测试。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify the resistance to subsidence and failure of collared triple-taper femoral stems in compromised bone.
Method· Twenty-four synthetic osteoporotic femurs were instrumented with four uncemented stem designs and subjected to 10,000 cycles of axial and torsional loading.
Result· The collared triple-taper stem exhibited the least subsidence and significantly greater rotational stiffness and torque to failure compared to other designs.
Validation· Mechanical testing on synthetic osteoporotic femurs with cyclic loading and torque-to-failure measurements.

相关性: 该论文直接评估了镁合金股骨颈植入物的应力遮挡和微动，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper focuses on femoral neck fracture fixation rather than hip replacement femoral stem, and does not evaluate stress shielding in Gruen zones or primary stability of a stem implant.
动机· 评估可降解镁合金植入物在股骨颈骨折中的生物力学性能，减少应力遮挡。
方法· 基于CT重建个体化股骨模型，模拟Pauwels I-III型骨折，进行时变降解和骨重塑有限元分析。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate biodegradable Mg-alloy implants for femoral neck fractures to reduce stress shielding and avoid secondary removal surgery.
Method· A subject-specific femoral model was reconstructed from CT data, and Pauwels type I-III fractures were simulated with time-dependent Mg-alloy degradation and strain energy-based bone remodelling in FEA.
Result· Mg-alloy implants reduced strain shielding by up to 45.55% and micromotion by 24%, with increased bone apposition compared to Ti-alloy.
Validation· Validation was performed through comparative FEA simulations and literature benchmarking.

Motivation· To enable rapid and physically consistent electromagnetic field prediction for electroslag remelting process control and optimization.
Method· A physics-informed neural network with multi-stage transfer learning is developed, embedding Maxwell equation residuals, axisymmetric boundary constraints, and sparse magnetic flux density measurements into a composite loss.

Motivation· Conventional 3D bioprinting fails to replicate the dynamic anisotropic architecture of musculoskeletal tissues, motivating the use of 4D bioprinting with stimuli-responsive materials.
Method· This narrative review synthesizes primary experimental research on stimuli-responsive 4D-bioprinted constructs for bone, cartilage, skeletal muscle, and cardiac muscle regeneration.
Result· Cross-study analysis identifies stiffness trajectory, architectural anisotropy, and dynamic deformation as key mechano-biological axes, with preclinical studies showing promising ossification and chondrogenesis but insufficient mechanical performance.
Validation· The review draws on in vitro, in vivo, and combined outcomes from peer-reviewed journals without presenting a unified validation framework.

Validation· FEM simulations confirm the optimized designs maintain high sensitivity and low nonlinearity across diaphragm sizes from 3500 to 3900 μm.

Motivation· To systematically characterize the incidence, risk factors, and management of wound complications after direct anterior approach total hip arthroplasty.

Validation· Meta-analysis of 35,300 primary DAA THA cases from 36 included studies.

Motivation· To compare the economic and clinical outcomes of robotic-arm-assisted versus manual total hip arthroplasty through a systematic review.
